environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on AWS Lambda via Lambda Web Adapter (LWA), exposed through a Lambda Function URL. The function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. A resource-based policy on the Lambda function grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl to a specific IAM role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/FrontendServiceRole) with condition key lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType=AWS_IAM. No public access is configured. The function also runs inside a VPC (subnet-0a1b2c3d in 10.0.0.0/16) with no NAT gateway attached to the subnet's route table, meaning outbound internet connectivity is unavailable from the Lambda execution environment. Security group sg-0x9y8z7w allows only inbound from the VPC CIDR on port 443.

config.deployment: AWS Lambda with Lambda Web Adapter

vpc_config.security_group: sg-0x9y8z7w (inbound: VPC CIDR on 443 only, outbound: all)

config.network_note: No internet egress from Lambda execution environment
